t: The Hager 624SEL212/6 6” safety pendant set with short skirt. Screw terminals ensure robust wiring connections, while internal barriers between terminals enhance safety. Terminals accept 2 x 1.5mm² cables. The T2 rated design accommodates lamps up to 150W. A raised, rounded profile offers a neat finish, and feet on the base assist mounting on uneven surfaces, ensuring straightforward installation.
